about: A statechart that invokes the standard shared record list (sce:std/shared/record_list.scxml) by its library name and hands it `announce`, passes it the host's words, and publishes what it was told: `shown`, the last register (its count and its first live value in the order of the dots), `others`, the further values told after it, and `told`, every event told. One register is written once, then twice at once by two people who had not seen each other's write (the later dot arriving first), then written over value by value until it holds none, then written again; a second register is written, a write already held is given again, and the list, made the hub, takes a change of its own that writes over two values and is told once. A change the list refuses is told as the command at fault, an edit, a clear or a retire (record_command), and why (record_refusal); the last refusal the parent keeps is an optional record (docs/adr/0055), absent (`null`) until there is one and the whole record after it. Expected values are computed by a model of the list, not observed from a backend.

steps.note: started: the list runs as the parent's child, and has told nothing; no change has been refused, so there is no last refusal: `refused` is absent
a register written once is told with its one value

a write made at once by someone who had not seen the first: the register holds two values, told as a count of 2 with the earlier dot first (node 2 before node 3, whichever arrived first) and the other after it, with its place
one of the two is written over: the register is told again, with the one left
the other is written over too: the register holds no value, told as a count of 0 with an empty value and dot
the write that wrote them over arrives: the register holds it alone
another field of the row is another register, told on its own
the same write given again is held already: nothing moves, and nothing is told
the host names the list the hub: nothing is told
a write made at once beside the clinic's: the register is told with both
the hub's own change over the field writes over both values it saw and writes its own, one change: the register it moved is told once, as it stands after the write
the host retires the row: each of its two registers is written over, and told once as holding nothing
a write to the row that its author made without seeing the retire arrives: the field comes back, told as any write is
the host lets the list's member, node 9, only read: nothing is told
an edit is refused for it, and the parent is told which command and why: nothing was written
so is a retire, a command of another kind, named by its row
and a clear, the third command, named by its register
the host lets the member write again
an edit whose text is one byte past what a person writes is refused, and the parent is told it was the text

data.text: a note that is one byte past it!!

steps.note: the host gives the list room for the values it holds and no more
an edit that would give a register its first value is refused for the room
the host lifts the room
a change that names one register twice begins: nothing is told yet
and is refused when it ends, the second command named, and told once
a change that edits a register and then clears it begins: nothing is told yet
and is refused when the clear ends it, named as the clear it was
a change that is taken in is told as its registers, and no refusal
